counterargs.read: The systemic layers improved -- the 20Y passed its test, funding is flat to IORB, and real yields and vol eased -- yet credit kept widening and is now the nearest trigger on the board (HY OAS 7bp from 3.5%). That pattern reads as duration repricing plus a late-cycle credit wobble, not Treasury intermediation stress. If HY OAS stalls here, the selloff looks contained; a break above 3.5% would complete Group C and, with MOVE above 80 (Group B), put the risk-off rule within one Group A signal of firing.
